diversity.desc: Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) are three interconnected concepts that aim to ensure everyone has equal access to opportunities and feels valued, regardless of their individual characteristics.

education.imgAlt: Circle of diverse and happy people
education.desc: We promote awareness through the platform. We encourage understanding and respect for differences, combating prejudices and stereotypes. The IncluMove team embraces all users.

wellbeing.title: Well Being
wellbeing.imgAlt: Woman walking while having positive thoughts
wellbeing.desc: OMS defines well-being as a state of complete physical, mental, and social well-being, not merely the absence of disease or infirmity. It is a holistic concept that encompasses various aspects of life, including physical health, mental health, emotional health, and social relationships.

mission.title: Our mission!
mission.desc: To democratize a technological solution that promotes access to physical, mental, and social well-being through an inclusive and welcoming platform. We want all bodies — with or without limitations — to be welcomed by our application and find in it a safe space for physical activities.

team.title: About us!
team.desc:
Our development team is made up of three third-year Systems Development students from ETEC Bento Quirino: Henrique Professor, Rodrigo Scatolin, and Samuel Augusto. Passionate about web development, we joined forces to complete the Hackteen challenge.

We thought a lot about the theme and decided to create an application that could help people with disabilities to exercise, since physical well-being is essential for everyone's mental and social health. Our goal is for IncluMove to be without limitations, so we dedicated a lot of time to ensuring the site's responsiveness and accessibility.

We had the support of our Web Programming teachers, classmates and relatives, who inspired us to create this project. At last, we thank everyone who helped us on this journey!
